Subject: Your breach of contract matter (Project Flamingo)

Dear Ms. Qureshi,

Thank you for meeting us on 20 October 2020 about your dispute with Coastal Industries. As we understand it, the goods supplied were defective.

Our advice is to claim liquidated damages as fixed in the contract. Please collect the inspection reports and the rejection notices and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Mrinalini Saraf
